subject: Data minimization & sampling plan for tenant deletion evidence
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@civicbank.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: CivicBank Security Team <security@civicbank.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: sampling method & artifacts for tenant deletion evidence

Hi Karthik,

As part of our SOC 2 review we need a small set of deletion artifacts we can consume and verify end-to-end for one of our tenants on your platform. Specifically we need:

- A description of your sampling methodology for tenant data erasures (how you select objects/tenants for proof of deletion)
- A small sample (up to 5 items) of deletion logs or manifests tied to those objects (timestamps and identifiers obfuscated)
- The storage paths or S3 keys for each object and the configured TTL/retention policy at time of deletion
- Any deletion runbook steps and responsible roles for the erasure operation

Can you confirm whether you can (a) provide a documented sampling plan and (b) share a redacted sample set next week? We are trying to close the evidence package by 28 May.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Lead Security Auditor, CivicBank

---
Note: If it helps, a PDF with the methodology and a couple of CSV log rows is perfect.
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@civicbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: sampling method & artifacts for tenant deletion evidence

Lena — thanks for the clear ask. We can provide a documented sampling methodology and a redacted sample set.

Quick clarifying Qs so we scope correctly:
1) Do you want a tenant-level deletion (full account wipe) or object-level deletions within a tenant?
2) Is it acceptable for us to obfuscate tenant IDs but keep consistent mapping across artifacts (so you can correlate log rows to S3 keys)?
3) Do you require signed attestations from ops that the deletion job executed, or are syslog/CloudTrail/our deletion logs sufficient?

Proposed timeline: initial sampling plan + runbook (PDF) by EOD 20 May, redacted CSV and TTL mapping by 21 May. That should give you a couple of days to ingest before 28 May.

Cc'ing Marissa (legal) and Neha (security) to pull the artifacts and confirm redaction approach.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: sampling method & artifacts for tenant deletion evidence

Karthik / Neha — thanks for the ping. For CivicBank we should provide:

- "Sampling approach" PDF (high level): random stratified sampling across tenant size buckets (micro, small, large) with N=3 tenants for the evidence package. Rationale: covers variance in TTL settings and deletion windows.
- Redacted deletion log sample: 3 rows per tenant, with tenant_id replaced by a stable pseudonym (e.g., T-001), timestamps in ISO8601, object key hashed (sha256 truncated) and deletion_job_id present.
- TTL/retention mapping: a one-page text file listing the S3 path patterns and the TTL value at time of deletion.
- Ops runbook excerpt: steps that the deletion worker follows + who signs off (Service Ops role).

I will draft the PDF today and put artifacts in a restricted Drive folder. For attestations: legal prefers we don't provide signed employee attestations for every deletion; logs and the runbook + an internal audit Jira ticket (SEC-4821) should suffice. If CivicBank insists we can add a timestamped Ops confirmation email.

Attachments (planned): deletion_sampling_plan.pdf, s3-paths-and-ttl-mapping.txt, deletion_log_sample.csv (redacted).

Neha — can you extract the three pseudonymized tenant deletion traces from the deletion index and drop them into the Drive link? Please ensure PII is removed and object keys are hashed.

Marissa
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: sampling method & artifacts for tenant deletion evidence

Done — I pulled three deletion jobs that ran in April (jobs: del-20260403-12, del-20260417-07, del-20260429-21). I created a redacted CSV with the following columns: pseudonym_tenant, deletion_job_id, object_key_hash, deleted_at, s3_path_pattern, ttl_seconds. Sample rows (redacted) are in the CSV.

Storage paths and TTLs live in the central mapping so I added a small text file mapping the s3 path patterns to TTL values as of the deletion time. Note: one of the tenants was on a 90-day TTL and two on 30-day TTL; we call that out in the PDF.

Drive link (restricted): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-deletion-evidence (access granted to civicbank@civicbank.com)

Attachment stubs included in the folder: [deletion_sampling_plan.pdf], [deletion_log_sample.csv], [s3-paths-and-ttl-mapping.txt].

Neha
Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@civicbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 16:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: sampling method & artifacts for tenant deletion evidence

Lena — attaching the artifacts we discussed and a brief summary. Let us know if you need signed attestation language; happy to provide a timestamped Ops confirmation email but prefer to avoid individual signatures unless required by audit policy.

Summary (what's in the Drive):
- deletion_sampling_plan.pdf — stratified sampling rationale, selection algorithm, and inclusion criteria (N=3 tenants, micro/small/large).
- deletion_log_sample.csv — 9 rows (3 per tenant); columns: pseudonym_tenant, deletion_job_id, object_key_hash, deleted_at (ISO8601), s3_path_pattern, ttl_seconds.
- s3-paths-and-ttl-mapping.txt — mapping of path prefixes to TTL values at deletion time.

Attachment stubs: [deletion_sampling_plan.pdf (PDF, 42 KB)], [deletion_log_sample.csv (CSV, 1.2 KB)], [s3-paths-and-ttl-mapping.txt (TXT, 0.9 KB)].

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-deletion-evidence
JIRA: SEC-4821 (internal audit ticket correlating deletion runs)

If the CivicBank security team wants additional correlation (e.g., CloudTrail event ids or a signed ops confirmation), tell us the minimum data elements you need and we'll scope it. Otherwise we expect these artifacts should satisfy the SOC 2 sampling review.

Best,
Karthik
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
